# SplatTransform API

> The API reference of the `@playcanvas/splat-transform` {{VERSION}} library: reading, processing and writing 3D Gaussian splat data in Node.js and the browser.

The command-line tool is documented in the [SplatTransform index](https://developer.playcanvas.com/user-manual/splat-transform/llms.txt) of the User Manual, with a guide to using the library.
